items: LAGOS STATE (PSI 9.2): Lagos Deploys ₦5b MSME Matched Funds, Expands Alimosho Hospital, and Heightens Ebola Airport Surveillance
BAYELSA STATE (PSI 8.8): Gov. Diri Implements New Civil Service Pay Packages and Unveils BMU AI Robotic Tutor
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 8.7): Plateau Council on Health Approves 10 Resolutions; Specialist Hospital Upgraded to Teaching Hospital
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 8.6): ADSEMA Disburses Flood Relief; Gov. Fintiri Donates ₦65m to Hospitals and ₦50m to Igbo Association
JIGAWA STATE (PSI 8.6): Gov. Namadi Bids Farewell to 65 Agricultural Scholars Departing for China Post-Graduate Studies
CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 8.5): Cross River Hosts South-South Food Crisis Summit; Obudu German Hospital Conducts Cancer Outreach
TARABA STATE (PSI 8.5): Gov. Kefas Summons Security Council over Binnari Attack; Redesignates Karim Lamido Security Concern Area
ABIA STATE (PSI 8.4): Gov. Otti Awards ₦1m Cash Rewards and University Scholarship to Qatar Debate Champions
ENUGU STATE (PSI 8.3): Forest Guard Completes Inter-Agency Capacity Training; Pincode Wins ₦2m Good Governance Jingle Top Prize
EDO STATE (PSI 8.2): Gov. Okpebholo Charges Permanent Secretaries on Financial Discipline; EDOHERMA Regulates Health Scope
ONDO STATE (PSI 8.1): Gov. Aiyedatiwa Presents Staff of Office to Oba Akinnifesi as Pioneer Ekigbade of Bolorunduro
KWARA STATE (PSI 8.0): Kwara State Commences Rehabilitation Works on Erin-Ile--Offa--Oshogbo Federal Border Corridor
NASARAWA STATE (PSI 7.8): Gov. Sule Pledges Support to FRSC for Vehicle Registration Enforcement; Unveils Nasarawa United NPFL Jerseys
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 7.6): Zamfara Observes World Polio Day 2026; Highlights 90%+ Health Worker Salary Increment
EBONYI STATE (PSI 7.5): Ebonyi State Dispatches 100 Trainees to NITT Zaria for Heavy Equipment Operations Training

LAGOS (PSI 9.2): Released ₦5b MSME matched funding, added 20 beds to Alimosho General Hospital Male Ward, intensified MMIA Ebola passenger screening, cleared multiple truck crashes, and launched online pension verification.

BAYELSA (PSI 8.8): Rolled out upgraded civil service pay with peculiar allowances, extended health worker retirement age to 65, unveiled BMU 5-year strategic plan, and launched an AI Robotic Tutor for digital learning.

PLATEAU (PSI 8.7): Approved 10 health resolutions including a Health Trust Fund and immunisation checks for school enrolment; Gov Mutfwang announced upgrade of Specialist Hospital to PLASU Teaching Hospital.
ADAMAWA (PSI 8.6): ADSEMA distributed flood relief in Madagali/Guyuk; Gov Fintiri donated ₦65m to hospital patients in Yola for his 59th birthday and ₦50m to the Igbo Cultural Association.
JIGAWA (PSI 8.6): Gov Umar Namadi presided over farewell ceremony for second batch of 65 scholars (15 PhD, 50 MSc) departing for China under the Jigawa-China Agricultural Cooperation Programme.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.5): Hosted South-South Food Crisis Preparedness Consultation highlighting Cowpea Programme; Mediatrix Foundation completed 3-day cancer screening outreach at Obudu German Hospital.
TARABA (PSI 8.5): Condemned armed attack on Binnari village; Gov Agbu Kefas convened emergency security meeting and redesignated Karim Lamido LGA as a Security Concern Area for 6 months.

ABIA (PSI 8.4): Awarded ₦1m each to 5 Qatar debate champions and full university scholarship to team captain Esther Christian; condoled with Dr. Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala; and celebrated Commodore Ukiwe at 86.
ENUGU (PSI 8.3): Forest Guard Command completed week-long joint capacity training; announced Pincode as ₦2m overall winner of the 2026 Good Governance Jingles Competition out of 157 entries.
EDO (PSI 8.2): EDOHERMA engaged private health practitioners on service scopes; Gov Okpebholo opened a 2-day Strategic Leadership Retreat for Permanent Secretaries emphasizing accountability.
ONDO (PSI 8.1): Gov Aiyedatiwa presented staff of office to pioneer Ekigbade of Bolorunduro, Oba Prof Thompson Akinnifesi, urging ruling houses to unite for local development.
KWARA (PSI 8.0): Commenced reconstruction work on the Erin-Ile--Offa--Oshogbo federal road following federal nod to alleviate border corridor hardship.
NASARAWA (PSI 7.8): Gov Sule pledged full support to FRSC to enforce vehicle registration and number plate licensing; received and unveiled Nasarawa United's 2026/27 NPFL jerseys.
ZAMFARA (PSI 7.6): Celebrated World Polio Day 2026 in Gusau, dedicating weekly broadcast airtime for UNICEF campaigns and highlighting 90%+ health worker salary increments.
EBONYI (PSI 7.5): Approved intensive short-term training for 100 Ebonyians in Mechanical Heavy Equipment Operations and Safety at NITT Zaria, with departure scheduled for Oct 26, 2026.
